notes.title: Server-Side Operations & Enhanced Anti-Cheat Measures in Version 1.1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey Raspberry Army!

Version 1.1.0.3 has arrived, and we're thrilled to announce a major update: we've transitioned to server-side operations. This means you can now seamlessly idle the game in the background while enjoying other games! Along with this, we've introduced new server-side anti-cheat measures to address market imbalances caused by the removal of Easy Anti-Cheat. Rest assured, we are diligently working to stabilize the market and anticipate resolving these issues soon.

ALL USERS MUST UPDATE THE GAME TO CONTINUE TO GET DROPS

- Custom anti-cheat improvements to stop speed hacking and exploits shown to us by the community.
- Drops are now handled by our servers
- Created a server to monitor drops as a way of detecting hackers
- Updated notifications to show you what you received
- Resolved issue where select players were not getting drops
- Loading now will reset your two hour timer but NOT your hours played.
    - Incentivizes the players to idle the game more.

notes.title: Huge update: Saving progress, equip skins, drop notifications and more
notes.notes:
Hello Raspberry Army!

We are excited to release the first major update after the initial beta test!

In this update, we you now have:


Ability to set the skin of the in-game raspberry to drops you have collected
Clicking the backpack icon in-game will show you all the items you have collected in a drop. You can view a full list of available items at https://getraspberries.com/database

Drop notifications
After each drop cycle, as scheduled. You will be show a message if  "You got a new  drop!", or "You did not get a drop this time..". This was designed to help users better understand drops.

New achievements
2 hidden achievements, and 4 achievements related to click goals

Saving click progress
Clicks now save and persistent even after the game has closed

Saving time in game in relation to drops
This now means that you can pickup where you left off after closing the game. For example, if you play the game for 1 hour 30 minutes, close the game and reopen later, you only have to wait 30 minutes to the hit the 2 hour scheduled drop. 

Easter eggs
We have scattered Easter eggs throughout the game. Let us know if you find them in discord!

...and various bug fixes reported to us in Discord or ones we have found on our own.


We hope you enjoy this update and we are continuing to add more features and designs everyday.

Join us on discord at  https://discord.gg/getraspberries
